subject: Quick pulse: CloudScale timing & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Raman <priya@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed MAP (CloudScale x Redwood)

Hi Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed mutual action plan so we have the same priorities: 

Summary of needs
- Low-latency text generation at scale for customer-facing workflows (20k reqs/day, 50 token avg)
- Data residency in us-east and audit logs for compliance
- Predictable per-call pricing for forecasting (monthly commit likely)

Proposed next steps (MAP)
1) Redwood to send MAP and SOC2 summary by EOD 6/11 — attached (CloudScale-MAP-v2.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
2) CloudScale to confirm budget owner and procurement timeline by 6/25
3) Tech touch: Ben to run a 30-min latency demo / benchmark (dates flexible)

Questions for you
- Is the financing/commit approval on the same EoQ cadence you mentioned? You said procurement would need to sign off before legal.

If that timing still works, I’ll loop in Sean for commercial review and draft a simple commitment to match your forecast. If timing has shifted, happy to reset dates.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the MAP and SOC2 summary attached.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: CloudScale-MAP-v2.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Priya Raman <priya@cloudscale.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudScale Procurement <procurement@cloudscale.io>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed MAP (CloudScale x Redwood)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary and the docs. Quick notes from my side: 

- MAP looks aligned with what we discussed; I’ve shared with procurement and legal.
- Budget has tentative approval from our head of product, pending procurement & legal sign-off. We are trying to close a few line items before quarter end but expect final sign-off if no major redlines.
- Can we tentatively schedule the tech demo the week of 6/16? Ben, what times work for you?

I’ll come back once procurement confirms a date.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product, CloudScale
priya@cloudscale.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Raman <priya@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — EoQ timing check

Priya — wanted to do a quick bump as we approach quarter close. A couple of things on my side: 

- We haven’t locked a tech demo date yet; Ben is flexible but wanted to pin something before EoQ if procurement will be able to move.
- You mentioned budget was tentative — is the approval still targeted for 6/25? If procurement/legal need more time, totally understandable — just checking whether we should shift the MAP timing into next quarter.

If it helps, I can: 
- Host a 15-minute call with Sean (commercial) to walk procurement through license/commit details, or
- Share a concise one-page signature-ready SOW and DocuSign link to accelerate review.

Would you prefer a quick call this week or should we move target dates into July?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Raman <priya@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final pulse before quarter close — can we confirm priority?

Priya — looping Sean in for commercial questions. Quick, final pulse as EoQ closes today: 

- Is CloudScale still planning to finalize procurement this week, or has priority shifted to July?
- If procurement needs more time, we can do either: a short pilot (30 days free credits) to unblock technical validation, or schedule signature in July with preferred start-of-service date.

If it’s helpful, here are two concrete options: 
1) Sign now: I’ll send a DocuSign with the agreed MAP and schedule a kickoff for July 7. (DocuSign link below)
2) Shift to Q3: We’ll reschedule the tech demo and move the MAP milestones to a July start. No cost until you’re ready.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/track/ABC-123-CloudScale
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CS-2025-179

If I don’t hear back by EOD, I’ll assume priority has shifted and will follow up in early July. Either way, happy to be flexible.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
